en: A black-and-white image of a sculpted bust of a woman atop a decorated pedestal. The bust features an ornate floral motif and a serene expression on the woman's face. In the background, a plaque with text in Hungarian can be seen, suggesting a historical or commemorative context. The general setting appears to be outdoors, possibly in front of a significant building or museum.
